title: India's First Underwater Twin-Tube Tunnel Approved in Assam
summary: CCEA approves ₹18,662 crore underwater road-cum-rail tunnel under Brahmaputra River connecting Gohpur and Numaligarh.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 India's First Underwater Twin-Tube Tunnel Approved in Assam. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: CCEA approved India's **first underwater twin-tube road-cum-rail tunnel** under the Brahmaputra River (33.7 km corridor, ₹18,662 Cr), cutting travel distance by 240 km.
